title: Seedless Agent Wallet
summary: Give an AI agent its own SOL vault with per-transaction, daily and cooldown limits, plus a human kill switch.
what: An Anchor 0.31.1 program where a human creates a vault for one agent key. The agent can spend only within the on-chain policy; the human can stop or drain the vault at any time.
app_note: The page at /dapps/seedless-agent-wallet/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/seedless-agent-wallet. The lab only changed declare_id to a unique lab program.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/seedless-agent-wallet/, switch to Devnet, connect a wallet and call create_vault with your own wallet as authority and a second key as agent.
try_steps.see: A vault PDA owned by the lab program with your policy.
try_steps.ran: create_vault, deposit, two agent_withdraw calls, emergency_stop, drain_vault (see steps).

diagram: authority --create_vault--> vault PDA (policy); anyone --deposit--> vault; agent --agent_withdraw--> destination (caps, cooldown); authority --emergency_stop / drain_vault--> vault off, funds back
innovation: The agent never holds the funds: its key can only move lamports out of a PDA under limits the human set, and the human can stop it in one transaction.
exercises: Why does agent_withdraw subtract the rent-exempt minimum before checking funds?
How would you add a destination allow-list?
